purpose: Concepts the source paper uses without defining, because it was written for a TinyML-specialist readership. This session's target audience (adjacent ML researchers) will need each of these defined at first use.

undefined_in_source.source_usage: used from the abstract onward as a field name
undefined_in_source.note: defined loosely once ('ML inference under a milliWatt') but never contrasted with mobile/edge ML for a non-specialist

assumed familiar; never given a concrete resource envelope until Section 2 ('two orders of magnitude smaller' than GB-scale mobile ML) -- needs a concrete number for an adjacent reader (10 MHz-250 MHz, <50 mW, per README_1.md)

used in Table 2 and Section 5.2 without spelling out the difference; an adjacent ML reader knows quantization exists but not this specific vocabulary or why the closed division permits only one of the two

undefined_in_source.term: DUT (device under test) / SUT (system under test)

implication_for_this_paper: A short Background section defining TinyML's resource envelope, the closed/open division idea, and PTQ vs. QAT before they are first used in Methods/Results is required for the stated audience (mode B); this maps to BACKGROUND_CONCEPT nodes in the story graph and to the term ledger's defined_at <= first_used_at rule.
